name: Claude Code Agents
body:
> Tool · 2026-10-22

# Summary
Custom Claude Code subagents live at user level in `C:\Users\kimbe\.claude\agents\`, so they work in every project. The agency handoff (Oct 1) lists six; a seventh, `video-notes-agent`, was added on Oct 22, 2026. The project folder `C:\TAG Marketing Claude\.claude\agents\` exists but is empty. An outbound-copywriter (Instantly) agent was offered and declined.

# The agents
| Agent | Model | What it does | Key rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| seo-blog-writer | opus | Keyphrase research, drafting, on-page and GEO structure, internal links, pre-delivery checklist | No em dashes; exact keyphrase in title/H1; no unbacked claims; no cannibalization; drafts only, never publishes. Pipeliners: "Pipeliners" only, no "pipeline/pipelining", author Jake Shaker. Opens with a "Quick answer" paragraph. |
| google-ads-analyst | opus | Audits the TAG MCC and writes copy-paste recommendation lists | Absolute read-only; knows the Pipeliners goal misconfig, 60s call gate and GHL lead-source labels |
| conversion-tracking-auditor | opus | Maps ad to landing page to conversion to GA4/GTM to GHL to Ads import; pass/fail per hop | Read-only; fix list ordered by dollar impact |
| local-seo-auditor | opus | SEO, AEO/GEO, schema, broken links, GSC indexing audits | Read-only on client sites; knows the Alphalete GSC crisis, duplicate H1 cause, Pipeliners MetaSync sitemap; about 13 manual indexing requests per day per property |
| wordpress-elementor-engineer | opus | Plans Elementor/WordPress clones, layouts and bulk edits | No live writes; footgun list (wp_slash on clone, never inject visible Elementor content via WP-CLI, SiteGround cache purge, Yoast indexable cache, Summit mu-plugin FAQs, Summit DNI) |
| eod-report-writer | sonnet | Compiles Kim's end-of-day report | Group by client, outcomes and numbers first, follow-ups mandatory, no em dashes |
| video-notes-agent | opus | Transcribes course videos locally with faster-whisper, reads slide frames, writes lesson notes for the vault | Free and local only; never uploads media |

# Related configuration
- User skills in `C:\Users\kimbe\.claude\skills\` include work-report, seo-geo-aeo, alphalete-local-copywriter, alphalete-local-page-builder, a set of SEO strategy skills and video (HyperFrames) skills.
- Project skills in `Pipeliners\.claude\skills\`: rebuild-local-page and restructure-local-page (Avondale layout).
- Plugins: Superpowers (installed Sep 28) and SearchFit SEO (generic; client blogs still go through seo-blog-writer).
- `C:\TAG Marketing Claude\.claude\launch.json` defines one dev server: `aio-seo-crm` (`npm --prefix AIO-SEO-CRM run dev`, port 3000) for [AIO SEO CRM](lib:brain-aio-seo-crm). `settings.local.json` holds local permissions (not summarized).

# Pending
- The eod-report-writer still looks for old EODs in the project root; EODs now live in `_Shared (All Clients)\EOD Reports\` (update on approval).
